description: career_complete: earn Gold on Coaster Chasm, the last scenario of Chapter 4.
career_mastery: earn Platinum on every scenario in the campaign.
Adds 20 checks outside the campaign: park ratings, guest counts, park value and coaster excitement targets.
These are reachable in Franchise, Challenge or Sandbox parks, so turn this on if you want checks you can grind outside career mode.
Adds trap items that instruct you to sabotage your own park: forced ride breakdowns, downpours, power outages.
Traps are honour-system, same as every other check in a Manual world.
